summary: This 7-of-8 segment is NOT photo-editor footage: it is a raw screen recording of Maude Studio's general canvas editor, showing the Claude/Maude-chat assistant autonomously resolving a design comment on a sports 'MVP' poster — nudging an image crop, inline-editing text labels, selecting/inspecting layers, and zooming in and out to check results. There is no AI background-removal pass, no template picker, no slider-driven crop/exposure adjustment, and no distinct before/after comparison anywhere in this stretch — the five brief beats (auto bg-removal, template pick, slider edit, fast finished result, user iterating on it) simply aren't present. Roughly 40% of the clip is dead reading time with zero on-screen change; the rest is small, legible UI actions (selection, inline text edit, undo toast, zoom) that are clean but off-topic for a photo-editor trailer. Recommend pulling the photo-editor beats from a different segment of the 8-part recording.
